summary: With the gate (freeze counting calls under way, thaw on a partial freeze) and the lease assumed to outlast the round, NoJobCutByQuit holds for 2 omps with 1 tool call each (149,573 states, depth 27; 2 calls each: 5,781,189 states, depth 31; 3 omps: 811,851 states) and both thaw liveness properties hold (2 omps, 1 call each); the old plain look and a gate that ignores calls under way each reach a quit that cuts a running job in 9 to 10 steps, and so does a lease that expires before the quit (documented residual). Model-level traces: not yet reproduced on the unchanged code.

modeled: JobGate enter/leave/agentEnded/freeze/thaw and the lease (job-gate.ts, composer.ts freeze_jobs/thaw_jobs/hooks)
main's freeze round: request, answers one by one, timeout, decide (install / thaw partial / hold), quit (background-work.ts, app-auto-update.ts #safeToInstall, updater.ts)
a tool call under way registering a job
abstracted: each omp is single-threaded; freeze_jobs's tree read and gate decision are one step
main's decision and the tick that follows are one step
messages in order and reliable; the lease has no clock
jobs are a count; members fixed during the round
out_of_scope: omps that become ready during the 3 s window
the tick's other holds, the user's postpone, idle(), a lost thaw request
relaunch continuing the cut turn, the installer
assumptions: A1: an omp handles requests in order (a thaw cannot overtake a later freeze)
A2: the 20 s lease outlasts the round (3 s timeout) and the install start (seconds on Windows)
A5: a job starts only from a tool call that passed the gate

findings.title: A plain look and a later quit cut a job that started between them (the old code)
findings.story: Main asks each omp for its jobs with composer.jobs (job-gate-less). Omp o1 answers: no job. A tool call of o1 then passes stock's tool_call hook (Enter) and registers a background job (a `bash` going to the background, a `task`). Omp o2 answers no job, main decides there is no work (DecideInstall) and the install runs; the quit finds a job running on o1 and cuts it. This is the field bug of 2 Nov 2026; the uncommitted fix (freeze_jobs + JobGate) closes it in the model: the same step sequence is impossible because o1's freeze closes the gate or reports the call under way. Suspected: the trace was not yet reproduced on the unchanged code by this unit (W1.6 belongs to the owner of the fix).

findings.title: Regression guard: a gate that does not count the tool calls under way would let a call register a job after the freeze
findings.story: Not in the shipped code: JobGate.freeze counts #underWay (job-gate.ts:74-75) and answers frozen:false with starting>0. In the variant where it does not, a tool call of o2 passes the gate, o1 and o2 both freeze (no job runs yet), main installs, and the call registers a job after the freeze; the quit cuts it. It shows why `starting` is part of the freeze and that the mutation drop-the-in-flight-check is detected.

findings.title: Documented residual: a lease that expires before the quit opens the gate again
findings.story: The gate's lease (20 s, at most 25 s) opens it on its own. If it fires after omp o1 answered frozen and before main's quit (during the 3 s answers window, or the installer start, seconds on Windows), a call of o1 passes the gate, registers a job, and the quit cuts it. The model has no clock: the passing runs assume it does not fire in that window (LeaseOutlastsRound=TRUE, assumption A2); this trace is what happens when the assumption fails. Whether the real timings allow it was not measured.
